files.what: LA County RR/CC layer "Division_Boundaries" (Los Angeles County District Division Boundaries, precinct derived; features re-created 9 September 2026), filtered to this body. GeoJSON, EPSG:4326. Division name in DivisionName, RR/CC code in Code. Not requested; captured because it came with the same query. 5 trustee areas.
